lesson: DD 7/22 overlay on weak alpha composite (D01_IdioVol + Q07_EarningsStability + C01_SUE, parent SR 0.479) destroyed more value than protected: -5.2pp CAGR for -10.6pp MDD (cost/benefit 0.49). When base SR < 0.5, drawdown brakes disproportionately suppress returns because the signal lacks sufficient excess return to absorb the dampening. Ref: Harvey & Siddique (2000) conditional skewness, Boyer et al. (2010) expected idiosyncratic skewness. S5 mutated D43->D01 which changed thesis from skewness premium to idiovol premium. The 3-family cross (Defense x Quality x Consensus) concept is sound but individual component alpha too weak for overlay application. DD calibration should only be applied to strategies with SR > 0.8 where the return buffer can absorb brake costs.
